articles.summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), the world's leading marketing and sales company, today announced the appointment of Tom Schwenger as Chief Executive Officer of Omnicom Health's marketing business, effective immediately. The unit previously reported into long-standing industry veteran, Dana Maiman, who will be leaving the company. In his new role, Schwenger will assume oversight of Omnicom Health's global marketing agencies. Together with the group's Agency Leaders and Integrated Client Leads, he will further develop and implement client engagement models, underpinned by Omni and Acxiom, tailored to the unique needs of pharma, biotech, and consumer healthcare clients. Schwenger will work closely with Michael Larson, who remains Chairman of Omnicom Health, on the leadership transition. Larson will also directly oversee Omnicom Health's specialty health business. articles.title: Omnicom Appoints Tom Schwenger as CEO of Omnicom Health Marketing
